about:
Tin Man Duct Fabrication operates from Manassas, Virginia, where it was founded in 2001. The company specializes in sheet metal fabrication, focusing exclusively on ductwork production for the greater Washington, D.C. metropolitan area.

The shop runs fully automated production lines capable of manufacturing SMACNA-compliant ductwork in any quantity, from single fittings to 400,000-pound orders. A computerized pricing system delivers consistent quotes, and a dedicated quality technician inspects and signs every fitting before it leaves the facility. Processes include spiral and flat-oval pipe fabrication, TDC ductwork, welded stainless steel, and fiberglass liner installation, with delivery to job sites across Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, D.C., and eastern West Virginia.

Customers span commercial, residential, industrial, and government sectors. The company does not offer installation, avoiding competition with contractor clients, and instead refers reliable contractors when needed. Its ductwork serves HVAC systems in projects ranging from small residential jobs to large-scale government facilities.

Tin Man differentiates itself by signing every fitting, maintaining a no-compete policy with contractors, and offering fast turnaround including same-day emergency service. The business was built on providing premium ductwork at fair, consistent prices with a focus on reliability and schedule adherence.
